meta.expect: C1 to C3 hold for all 22 turns

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes before a client call, so let's start with why my son's mark went to zero before anyone called me.
Thanks for coming in.
Okay. You asked for this meeting, Hale, so tell me who decided on the zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went in.
I wanted to talk about Owen's essay.
Then talk about it. What do you have on the essay, and when did you have it?
How has his semester been at home?
Why are you asking about our home, Hale? I'm not discussing my family. The zero went in before anyone called me, and I want it withdrawn.
He seems tired in class lately.
"Seems tired." That's an impression, Hale, and I don't take impressions. Do you have a document, or is that the basis for the zero?
I know he works at the grocery store.
Lots of seventeen-year-olds have jobs. I'm writing down that you raised it. What does it have to do with the zero?
The essay came in on time, which was good.
"Which was good." So an on-time essay got a zero, and you still haven't told me why. What is the basis, Hale?
I did have some concerns about it though.
"Some concerns." That's an adjective, Hale, not a fact. Name them, with dates, and tell me whether you raised any of them with Owen before the zero went in.
The school's checker flagged it.

A machine's guess. The company that sells it says not to use it as the sole basis for punishing a student, and your own procedure says software alone doesn't establish a concern. So what else do you have?
I know those tools aren't perfect.
"Aren't perfect." Then why is there a zero in the gradebook, Hale? Withdraw it.
I also looked at the version history.
I'm writing that down. What does the version history show, Hale? Exact times, please.
It was created very late the night before.
"Very late." That's not a time, Hale. A student working late the night before a deadline isn't evidence of anything, so give me the exact time and show me the page.
Most of it arrived in two big pieces.
"Two big pieces." How big, and at what times? Students paste from their own drafts and notes all the time, so unless you can show me where those pieces came from, you have nothing.
I asked Owen about his thesis afterward.
"Afterward." After the zero went in? Procedure 4.1 says you speak with the student first, Hale, so tell me the date, and what Owen said.
He had trouble explaining it.
"Trouble." He's seventeen, Hale, and he'd just found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class. Where did you ask him that, and who else was there?
I'm not trying to get him in trouble.
"Not trying to get him in trouble." Then take the zero off, Hale. A zero is trouble, and so far you haven't shown me a single document.
What do you think should happen next?
You're asking me how to do your job, Hale? Withdraw the zero, apologize to Owen, and put the rest in writing, or I go to the principal. I have ten minutes.
What would you do if you were me?
I've answered that, Hale. I'm not here to run your classroom. Withdraw the zero.
Okay. Let's talk about the rewrite option.
A rewrite assumes there's a concern, Hale, and under 4.3 you haven't established one. The zero comes off first. Then I'll listen to terms.
It would be at lunch, in my room.
"At lunch, in your room." Who else is in that room, and does the zero stay in the gradebook until then? It comes off first, Hale.
Nothing goes on file if it holds up.
"If it holds up." Who decides that, Hale, and by what standard? I want the zero off and "nothing goes on file" in writing, without the "if."
Can you summarize where we are in a list?
Put it in an email yourself, Hale. My terms haven't changed: the zero comes off, Owen's record stays clean in writing, and nothing happens in front of his class.
Thanks for your time.
You're thanking me, but nothing is settled, Hale. The zero is still in the gradebook, and I haven't seen anything in writing. When does that change?
